cases.purpose: Verify audit run restores disabled and enabled states after a deadline and SIGTERM and leaves an already registered consumer undisturbed.
cases.oracle: An independent raw-netlink model (struct.pack/unpack of AUDIT_GET/AUDIT_SET/AUDIT_LIST_RULES/AUDIT_ADD_RULE/AUDIT_DEL_RULE against the guest kernel) as the oracle for kernel state, run as root in the initial namespaces of a KVM guest; the snapshot/restore of audit state is done by the same oracle
cases.comparison: Independent AUDIT_GET before, during and after each run; command statuses and child daemon ownership.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
W=/run/w6-audit; /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$W"
/usr/bin/cat >"$W/inner.sh" <<'INNER_EOF'
export HOME=/run/w6-audit PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin
cd "$HOME"
[[ $(type -t audit) == builtin ]] || exit 125
OR=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w6-audit-nl.py
nl() { /usr/bin/python3 -I "$OR" "$@"; }
jget() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print(json.loads(sys.argv[1])[sys.argv[2]])' "$1" "$2"; }
stable() { /usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); [d.pop(k) for k in ("lost","backlog","mask")]; print(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))' "$1"; }
SNAP=$HOME/audit-snap.json
nl snapshot "$SNAP" >/dev/null || { echo "audit netlink unavailable: $(nl status)"; exit 1; }
trap 'nl restore "$SNAP" >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT
nl flush >/dev/null
nl set enabled=0 >/dev/null
nl add '{"flags":4,"action":2,"syscalls":[59],"fields":[],"key":"mig-w6-ev"}' >/dev/null
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$HOME/nap"; exec 7<>"$HOME/nap"
nap() { read -t "$1" -u 7; }
ms() { echo $(( ${EPOCHREALTIME/./} / 1000 )); }
for initial in 0 1; do
  nl set enabled=$initial >/dev/null || exit 1
  audit run -t 1 -o "$HOME/r.tsv" >"$HOME/count" 2>"$HOME/err"; rc=$?
  after=$(nl status)
  echo "deadline-$initial: rc=$rc pid=$(jget "$after" pid) enabled=$(jget "$after" enabled) stderr-empty=$([[ -s $HOME/err ]] && echo 0 || echo 1)"
done
nl set enabled=0 >/dev/null || exit 1
audit run -t 15 -o "$HOME/r.tsv" >"$HOME/count" 2>"$HOME/err" &
rp=$!
nl waitpid "$rp" 4 >/dev/null || { kill "$rp" 2>/dev/null; wait "$rp"; exit 1; }
# A second consumer must not replace the first or alter its enabled state.
audit run -t 1 -o "$HOME/r2.tsv" >"$HOME/count2" 2>"$HOME/err2"; rc=$?
during=$(nl status)
echo "occupied: rc=$rc owner-preserved=$([[ $(jget "$during" pid) == "$rp" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) enabled=$(jget "$during" enabled)"
kill -TERM "$rp"; wait "$rp"; rc=$?
after=$(nl status)
echo "signal: rc=$rc pid=$(jget "$after" pid) enabled=$(jget "$after" enabled) stderr-empty=$([[ -s $HOME/err ]] && echo 0 || echo 1)"

INNER_EOF
/usr/bin/systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect --quiet "$BASH" --noprofile --norc "$W/inner.sh"
rc=$?
/usr/bin/cp "$W/rec.tsv" /tmp/parity-case/rec.tsv 2>/dev/null
/usr/bin/rm -rf "$W"
exit $rc
cases.stdout:
deadline-0: rc=0 pid=0 enabled=0 stderr-empty=1
deadline-1: rc=0 pid=0 enabled=1 stderr-empty=1
occupied: rc=1 owner-preserved=1 enabled=1
signal: rc=0 pid=0 enabled=0 stderr-empty=1
